title: Best customer support analytics tools for teams on Zendesk, Intercom, and Freshdesk (2026): 9 options compared
summary: Zendesk Explore, Intercom, Freshdesk, Geckoboard, Databox, SentiSum, Power BI, Metabase, and Basedash compared on refresh speed, Slack alerts, AI, and price.
body_markdown:
For most support teams, the best analytics tool is the one already inside the help desk: Zendesk Explore, Intercom reports, or Freshdesk Analytics cover standard metrics like first response time, CSAT, and SLA breaches without extra cost. Teams add a second tool when they need something the help desk can’t do: Geckoboard or Databox for live wallboards and Slack alerts, SentiSum for AI tagging of every conversation at enterprise scale, and Power BI, Metabase, or Basedash when support data has to be joined with product, billing, or CRM data. Every price below was checked on the vendor’s official page on October 12, 2026.


## What support teams need from an analytics tool


The questions support leaders ask when they shop for reporting are more specific than “which dashboard tool is best”. They want to know whether a tool will show today’s queue in real time, warn the team in Slack when tickets spike, explain *why* contact volume moved, and connect ticket data to the customers and revenue behind it.


That splits the market into four groups:


- **Native help desk reporting** (Zendesk Explore, Intercom, Freshdesk). Included with the help desk, built around its data model, and limited to that data.
- **KPI dashboard and wallboard tools** (Geckoboard, Databox). Connect to help desks through their APIs, put metrics on a TV or in Slack, and add alerts.
- **AI conversation analytics** (SentiSum). Reads the text of every ticket and chat to find contact reasons, sentiment, and root causes.
- **BI tools** (Power BI, Metabase, Basedash). Query support data alongside the rest of the business, usually after the help desk data lands in a warehouse.


## How we evaluated customer support analytics tools


We compared each tool on the criteria that come up in buyer questions about support reporting:


1. **Help desk connections.** Does it connect to Zendesk, Intercom, and Freshdesk natively, through a partner, or only through a warehouse?
2. **Data freshness.** What is the fastest documented refresh for historical reports and for live queue views, and on which plan?
3. **Alerts.** Can it send Slack or email alerts on thresholds or anomalies, such as a spike in tickets tagged “outage”?
4. **AI analysis.** Can a support lead ask a question in plain English, get topic and sentiment analysis from ticket text, or receive AI-written explanations of changes?
5. **Joining other data.** Can ticket data be combined with product usage, billing, or CRM data to answer questions like “which plan tier files the most tickets”?
6. **Price and security.** Starting price, pricing model, and whether SAML SSO is included.

## Zendesk Explore


**Best for:** Zendesk teams that need standard ticket, agent, and SLA reporting without another vendor.


Zendesk Explore ships with every Zendesk plan, but the plan decides what it can do. Suite Team gets Explore Lite with prebuilt dashboards that refresh once a day. Custom reports, hourly refresh, and dashboard sharing start on Suite Professional. Explore only reports on Zendesk data, and the[dataset documentation](https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408846513050-Working-with-datasets) describes no way to blend in product or billing data.


**Fact card: Zendesk Explore**


- **Pricing (as of October 2026):** included with Zendesk. Support Team $19, Suite Team $55, and Suite Professional $115 per agent per month billed annually ($25, $69, and $149 billed monthly); Suite Enterprise by quote ([pricing](https://www.zendesk.com/pricing/) ).
- **Free trial:** 14 days of Suite Professional.
- **Deployment:** software-as-a-service only.
- **Explore tiers:**[Lite on Team plans, Professional on Suite Professional, Enterprise on Suite Enterprise](https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408823356186-About-the-Zendesk-Explore-plan-types) .[Custom reports](https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408821589530-Creating-reports) need Explore Professional or Enterprise.
- **Query model:** historical data[syncs daily on Team plans and hourly on Professional and up](https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408823242778-Data-refresh-intervals-for-analytics) . Live dashboards refresh in 5 to 10 seconds; accounts that first opened Explore after May 5, 2026 use real-time monitoring dashboards instead.
- **Sharing and exports:** dashboards are shared with Zendesk users and[scheduled by email](https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408843602714-Scheduling-dashboard-deliveries) (to end users on Enterprise).[Dataset exports](https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/6037992005914-Exporting-datasets-from-Explore) send CSV files on a schedule, up to 14 recurring exports.
- **AI features:**[AI quick reports](https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/9434807221914-Creating-AI-powered-quick-reports-using-natural-language) build a report from a plain-English request on Suite Professional, but only on the tickets dataset, without custom fields, and not on live data.[Agentic analytics](https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/10468673224474-Getting-started-with-agentic-analytics-EAP) is in early access, refreshes daily, and added[email and Slack alerts](https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/11328554142618-Announcing-alerts-in-agentic-analytics-EAP) in October 2026.[Intelligent triage](https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/7934127855002-Overview-of-the-Intelligent-triage-dashboard) reports on intent, sentiment, and language on Professional and up.
- **Security:**[SAML SSO](https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408887505690-Enabling-SAML-single-sign-on) on every Suite plan.
- **Not ideal for:** joining tickets with revenue or product data, or teams on Suite Team that need anything fresher than yesterday.


## Intercom reports


**Best for:** Intercom teams that want conversation and Fin AI agent reporting in the same place they work.


Intercom includes prebuilt reports on every plan and custom reports from Advanced up. The features support leads tend to ask about most, the real-time dashboard and SAML SSO, sit on Expert. AI analysis of conversation content is a separate Pro add-on.


**Fact card: Intercom reports**


- **Pricing (as of October 2026):** Essential $19, Advanced $85, and Expert $132 per seat per month billed annually on the[pricing page](https://www.intercom.com/pricing) ; the[seats article](https://www.intercom.com/help/en/articles/8205716-seats) lists $39, $99, and $139 billed monthly. Fin AI Agent costs $0.99 per outcome.
- **Free trial:** 14 days with all features and add-ons, no credit card.
- **Deployment:** software-as-a-service only.
- **Reports by plan:** prebuilt reports on Essential;[custom reports](https://www.intercom.com/help/en/articles/200-intercom-reports-explained) from 100+ chart types on Advanced and Expert.
- **Query model:** the[real-time dashboard](https://www.intercom.com/help/en/articles/5784131-real-time-dashboard) is Expert only and updates about every minute while the tab is open. Reports can be[scheduled by email](https://www.intercom.com/help/en/articles/13004328-schedule-sharing-your-reports-externally) , including to external addresses.
- **Exports:** CSV exports of 13 reporting datasets, and[hourly or daily exports to Amazon S3 or Google Cloud Storage](https://www.intercom.com/help/en/articles/7029721-export-conversations-data-to-cloud-storage) . No native Snowflake or BigQuery export is documented.
- **AI features:** the[Pro add-on](https://www.intercom.com/help/en/articles/17217972-pro-add-on) costs $100 per month for 500 analyzed conversations, then $0.20 per conversation. It adds CX Score (an AI rating of every conversation), Topics Explorer, weekly trend reports, and real-time incident detection with Slack, email, or webhook alerts.
- **Security:**[SAML SSO on Expert only](https://www.intercom.com/help/en/articles/3974587-integrate-with-an-identity-provider-and-log-in-with-saml-sso) .
- **Not ideal for:** teams on Essential or Advanced that need a live queue view or SSO, or anyone reporting across Intercom and another system.


## Freshdesk Analytics


**Best for:** Freshdesk teams that want curated support reports on any plan and AI insights without a separate add-on on Enterprise.


Freshdesk’s curated reports, including performance and SLA reports, are on every plan. Custom reports, scheduled reports, and raw data exports start on Pro.[All reports refresh every 30 minutes](https://support.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/239757-introduction-to-analytics) regardless of plan.


**Fact card: Freshdesk Analytics**


- **Pricing (as of October 2026):** Growth $19, Pro $55, and Enterprise $89 per agent per month billed annually ($23, $66, and $107 billed monthly) ([pricing](https://www.freshworks.com/freshdesk/pricing/) ).
- **Free trial:** 14 days of Enterprise.
- **Deployment:** software-as-a-service only.
- **Reports by plan:**[custom reports, scheduling, and data export on Pro and Enterprise](https://support.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/50000001108-analytics-features-for-each-plan) . Scheduled reports export as PDF only;[raw data exports](https://support.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/50000000033-exporting-your-data-in-analytics) send CSV daily, weekly, or monthly.
- **Query model:** 30-minute refresh on every plan.
- **AI features:**[Freddy AI Insights](https://support.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/50000011772-root-cause-analysis-in-freshdesk) on Enterprise, with[proactive insights](https://support.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/50000011660-proactive-insights-in-freshdesk) that monitor 7 default helpdesk metrics, root cause analysis, and conversational insights that answer questions with charts.
- **Security:** SAML SSO on Growth, Pro, and Enterprise ([SSO options](https://support.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/50000001658-single-sign-on-in-freshdesk) also include OAuth, OIDC, and JWT).
- **Not ideal for:** minute-by-minute queue monitoring or reporting that spans other systems.


## Geckoboard


**Best for:** support teams that want live queue metrics on an office TV and in Slack with almost no setup.


Geckoboard connects natively to Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk, Help Scout, and Gorgias and turns their metrics into simple wallboard dashboards. It reads help desk data through each vendor’s API, so freshness depends on the integration:[Zendesk Support widgets update every 10 minutes, Zendesk Chat every minute, and Zendesk Talk every 30 seconds](https://www.geckoboard.com/integrations/zendesk/) . For deeper Geckoboard detail and its competitors, see our[Geckoboard alternatives comparison](https://www.basedash.com/blog/geckoboard-alternatives-2026-kpi-dashboard-tools-compared) .


**Fact card: Geckoboard**


- **Pricing (as of October 2026):** Essentials from $79 per month billed annually or $99 monthly (2 dashboards, 1 editor, 1 screen); Performance from $319 or $399 (20 dashboards, 3 editors, 5 screens); Enterprise by quote ([pricing](https://www.geckoboard.com/pricing/) ).
- **Free trial:** 14 days; no free plan.
- **Deployment:** software-as-a-service only.
- **Support data limits:** Zendesk Support imports[90 days of history](https://support.geckoboard.com/en/articles/6055512-connect-your-zendesk-support-data-to-geckoboard) and then keeps storing data. Plans cover[2,500 tickets created per month on Essentials and 5,000 on Performance](https://support.geckoboard.com/en/articles/6908232-data-volume-allowances-and-add-ons) , with 10,000-ticket add-ons on Performance.
- **Alerts:** threshold alerts to Slack or Microsoft Teams on Performance; scheduled Slack snapshots on every plan.
- **AI features:** a read-only Metrics MCP server for Claude or ChatGPT. No AI summaries or anomaly detection in the product.
- **Security:** SAML SSO on Enterprise.
- **Not ideal for:** high-volume Zendesk accounts on Essentials, or teams that want to know why a metric moved.


## Databox


**Best for:** support and success teams that want KPI dashboards across their help desk, CRM, and billing tools with AI summaries and a free starting point.


Databox connects to Zendesk (through an integration[rebuilt in 2025](https://help.databox.com/integrate-zendesk-with-databox) ), Intercom, Freshdesk, Help Scout, and HubSpot Service alongside 130+ other sources, which makes it a quick way to put CSAT next to churn or pipeline numbers. Watch the volume limits: Databox reads the[most recently updated 2,400 closed Intercom conversations](https://databox.com/metric-library/data-source/intercom) and[up to 30,000 Freshdesk tickets](https://databox.com/metric-library/data-source/freshdesk) .


**Fact card: Databox**


- **Pricing (as of October 2026):** Free (1 user, 3 data sources, daily sync); Analyst $71 per month billed annually or $89 monthly; Team Core $199 or $249 (3 users, 10 sources); Team Scale $319 or $399 (10 users, 30 sources) ([pricing](https://databox.com/pricing) ). No per-seat pricing.
- **Free tier or trial:** free plan, plus a 14-day trial with no payment details.
- **Deployment:** software-as-a-service only.
- **Query model:** synced data, hourly on paid plans. A 15-minute sync costs $14 per month per source on annual billing, where the source’s API allows it.
- **Alerts:** anomaly detection on every plan; alerts, scheduled snapshots, TV streaming, and sharing start on Team plans.
- **AI features:** the Genie AI analyst answers plain-English questions on every plan (using AI credits); Genie in Slack on Team plans; an MCP server from Analyst up.
- **Security:** SAML SSO through a $40 per month add-on; SCIM not supported.
- **Not ideal for:** large Intercom or Freshdesk accounts that hit the conversation and ticket caps, or teams that need data fresher than 15 minutes.


For a broader look at this category, see our[Databox alternatives comparison](https://www.basedash.com/vs/databox-alternatives) .


## SentiSum


**Best for:** large support organizations that want AI to read every conversation and rank contact reasons by business impact.


SentiSum is not a dashboard tool for queue metrics. It[analyzes and tags every customer conversation](https://www.sentisum.com/integrations/zendesk-sentiment-analysis) in 100+ languages for contact reason and sentiment, without a tag taxonomy to maintain, and its agents flag emerging issues and estimate what each one costs. It answers the question native reports struggle with: *why* customers are contacting support.


**Fact card: SentiSum**


- **Pricing (as of October 2026):** one annual contract[from $100,000](https://www.sentisum.com/pricing) , with volume agreed in bands rather than metered per ticket. Quality, automation, and MCP access cost extra.
- **Free trial:** a free evaluation on a slice of your own conversations.
- **Deployment:** software-as-a-service; SOC 2 Type II and EU data residency.
- **Help desk connections:** native integrations with Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk, Gorgias, Dixa, and Salesforce, among others ([homepage](https://www.sentisum.com/) ).
- **Alerts:** the[Early Warning agent](https://www.sentisum.com/product/early-warning-agent) sends real-time alerts by email, Slack, and Teams.
- **AI features:** automatic tagging, sentiment, root cause analysis, and an Insights agent that answers plain-English questions with dollar impact.
- **Security:** unlimited users, SSO, and API access included.
- **Not ideal for:** small and mid-size teams, or anyone whose main need is SLA and agent performance dashboards.


## Microsoft Power BI


**Best for:** Microsoft 365 organizations that want support data in the same reports as finance and operations.


Power BI connects to Zendesk through the[Zendesk Data connector](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-query/connectors/zendesk-data) , which Zendesk builds and maintains. It runs in Import mode and is labelled Beta or Preview in Power BI. Neither Intercom nor Freshdesk appears in the[Power Query connector list](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-query/connectors/) , so teams typically sync those tools into a warehouse first and connect Power BI to the warehouse.


**Fact card: Power BI**


- **Pricing (as of October 2026):** Pro $14 and Premium Per User $24 per user per month billed annually ([pricing](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/products/power-bi/pricing) ). Free accounts can’t share reports.
- **Free tier or trial:** free personal use in Power BI Desktop.
- **Deployment:** cloud service plus the Windows Desktop app.
- **Query model:** imported data refreshes up to 8 times a day on Pro and 48 on PPU.
- **Alerts:**[data alerts](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/create-reports/service-set-data-alerts) on gauges, KPIs, and cards, checked hourly or daily, by notification and email.
- **AI features:**[Copilot](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/create-reports/copilot-introduction) needs Fabric F2 or Premium P1 capacity; a Pro or PPU license alone is not enough.
- **Security:**[row-level security](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/fabric/security/service-admin-row-level-security) with DAX roles that apply to Viewers only; sign-in through Microsoft Entra ID.
- **Not ideal for:** live queue monitoring, or support teams without someone who builds Power BI models.


## Metabase


**Best for:** teams that already sync help desk data into a warehouse and want low-cost dashboards and alerts on top.


Metabase does not connect to Zendesk, Intercom, or Freshdesk directly. Its[supported data sources](https://www.metabase.com/docs/latest/databases/connecting) are databases and warehouses, so support data has to arrive through an ingestion tool first. Fivetran’s[Zendesk](https://fivetran.com/docs/connectors/applications/zendesk) ,[Intercom](https://fivetran.com/docs/connectors/applications/intercom) , and[Freshdesk](https://fivetran.com/docs/connectors/applications/freshdesk) connectors are a common route, with 15-minute syncs on its Standard plan and a free plan up to 500,000 monthly active rows ([pricing](https://fivetran.com/pricing) ).


**Fact card: Metabase**


- **Pricing (as of October 2026):** open source free; Starter $100 per month with 5 users, then $6 per user; Pro $575 per month with 10 users, then $12 per user; Enterprise from $20,000 per year ([pricing](https://www.metabase.com/pricing/) ).
- **Free tier or trial:** free self-hosted open source edition; trials of paid plans.
- **Deployment:** Metabase Cloud or self-hosted.
- **Query model:** live queries against the warehouse, so freshness equals your sync schedule.
- **Alerts:**[question alerts](https://www.metabase.com/docs/latest/questions/alerts) by the minute, hourly, or on a cron schedule, to email, Slack, or a webhook.
- **AI features:** Metabot, which works on any plan[with your own AI provider key](https://www.metabase.com/docs/latest/ai/settings) .
- **Security:**[SAML SSO](https://www.metabase.com/docs/latest/people-and-groups/authenticating-with-saml) and[row and column security](https://www.metabase.com/docs/latest/permissions/row-and-column-security) on Pro and Enterprise.
- **Not ideal for:** teams without a warehouse or someone to model raw help desk tables.


## Basedash


**Best for:** teams that want to ask questions across support, product, and billing data in plain English without building a pipeline.


Basedash is a general BI tool, not a help desk reporting product, so it does not ship prebuilt SLA or agent dashboards. It fits when the question crosses systems, such as “which customers on the enterprise plan opened the most urgent tickets this month”. Help desks like[Zendesk](https://www.basedash.com/data-sources/zendesk) , Intercom, Freshdesk, Gorgias, and Help Scout connect through managed connectors that sync into the[Basedash Warehouse](https://www.basedash.com/features/warehouse) , next to product databases and tools like Stripe or HubSpot. The[AI data analyst](https://www.basedash.com/features/ai-data-analyst) then writes the SQL, and charts can be saved to dashboards.


**Fact card: Basedash**


- **Pricing (as of October 2026):** Startup $1,000 per month plus AI usage, with up to 25 users and $1,000 of monthly AI credits; Enterprise custom ([pricing](https://www.basedash.com/pricing) ). Connectors are included, with no separate per-row ETL bill.
- **Free trial:** 14 days, no credit card.
- **Deployment:** cloud; self-hosting on Enterprise.
- **Query model:**[data ingestion](https://www.basedash.com/features/data-ingestion) connectors sync every 15 or 30 minutes, every 1 to 12 hours, or daily, and can run on demand. Databases and warehouses such as PostgreSQL, Snowflake, and BigQuery are queried live.
- **Alerts:**[automations](https://www.basedash.com/docs/features/automations) run on a schedule or when a SQL query detects new or changed data, and send AI-written updates by email or Slack.[Insights](https://www.basedash.com/features/insights) post notable changes on their own, with Slack or email notifications.
- **AI features:** chat-based analysis, AI-generated dashboards, a[Slack app](https://www.basedash.com/docs/features/slack) that answers @Basedash questions with charts, and an MCP server on every plan.
- **Security:**[row-level security](https://www.basedash.com/docs/features/row-level-security) for Postgres only, so it does not apply to warehouse-synced help desk data; SAML or OIDC SSO and SCIM on Enterprise.
- **Not ideal for:** teams that only need help desk metrics, minute-level queue monitoring, office wallboards, or budgets under a few hundred dollars a month.


## Other options worth knowing


**Google Data Studio** (renamed from Looker Studio in April 2026) has no Google-built Zendesk, Intercom, or Freshdesk connector. Partner connectors such as Windsor.ai and Coupler.io fill the gap, often for a fee, and Data Studio Pro costs $9 per user per project per month ([Data Studio](https://cloud.google.com/data-studio) ).


**Help desk add-ons** from the marketplaces of Zendesk and Intercom cover narrower jobs, such as QA scoring or time tracking. They are useful but outside the scope of a reporting comparison.


## Which customer support analytics tool should you choose?


**If you only need standard support metrics:** stay with Zendesk Explore, Intercom reports, or Freshdesk Analytics, and check your plan first. Zendesk custom reports and hourly data need Suite Professional, Intercom’s real-time dashboard needs Expert, and Freshdesk custom reports need Pro.


**If you need a live queue view and Slack alerts:** Geckoboard updates Zendesk Talk every 30 seconds and Zendesk Support every 10 minutes, with Slack alerts on Performance. Intercom Expert has a real-time dashboard that updates about every minute. Databox tops out at 15 minutes with a paid add-on.


**If you want to know why customers contact you:** SentiSum tags every conversation for reason and sentiment if the budget fits an enterprise contract. Intercom’s Pro add-on (CX Score and Topics Explorer) and Freshdesk Enterprise’s Freddy AI Insights cover a lighter version inside the help desk.


**If support data needs to sit next to revenue and product data:** Databox handles simple cross-tool KPIs. Power BI and Metabase work well once a warehouse holds the help desk data. Basedash syncs the help desk for you and lets non-technical leads ask cross-system questions in plain English.


**If you need SSO on a budget:** Freshdesk includes SAML SSO on Growth and Zendesk on every Suite plan. Intercom reserves it for Expert, Geckoboard for Enterprise, and Databox sells it as a $40 per month add-on.


**If you want AI alerts on support metrics:** our[AI anomaly detection comparison](https://www.basedash.com/blog/best-bi-tools-for-ai-anomaly-detection-and-smart-alerting-2026) covers how BI tools detect spikes and explain them.


## Frequently asked questions


### What is the best customer service analytics software?


For most teams it is the reporting built into their help desk: Zendesk Explore, Intercom reports, or Freshdesk Analytics. Those tools already understand tickets, agents, SLAs, and CSAT. Teams outgrow them when they need live wallboards (Geckoboard), cross-tool KPI dashboards with a free tier (Databox), AI analysis of every conversation at enterprise scale (SentiSum), or support data joined with product and billing data (Power BI, Metabase, or Basedash). Pick based on that gap, not on a general ranking.


### Is Zendesk Explore enough for support reporting?


Zendesk Explore is enough if you are on Suite Professional or higher and only report on Zendesk data. On Suite Team you get Explore Lite: prebuilt dashboards that refresh once a day, with no custom reports. Explore also cannot blend in data from other systems, so questions about revenue per ticket or churn after a bad support experience need a BI tool. Zendesk’s agentic analytics adds AI questions and Slack alerts, but it was still in early access with a daily refresh as of October 2026.


### How do I get Intercom data into Power BI?


Power BI has no native Intercom connector, so the usual path is to sync Intercom into a data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or PostgreSQL with an ingestion tool like Fivetran, then connect Power BI to the warehouse. Intercom can also export conversation data to Amazon S3 or Google Cloud Storage hourly or daily, and Power BI can read those files, though that takes more modeling work. CSV exports from Intercom reports work for one-off analysis but aren’t a sustainable feed.


### Which support analytics tools send Slack alerts when ticket volume spikes?


Geckoboard sends threshold alerts to Slack or Microsoft Teams on its Performance plan. Databox includes anomaly detection on every plan, with alerts on Team plans. Intercom’s Pro add-on adds real-time incident detection with Slack, email, or webhook alerts. SentiSum’s Early Warning agent alerts by Slack, email, or Teams. Metabase can check a question as often as every minute and post to Slack. Basedash automations can run when a SQL query finds new rows and send an AI-written summary to Slack.


### How can I analyze customer feedback and ticket topics with AI without writing SQL?


Inside the help desk, Intercom’s Pro add-on groups conversations into topics and scores each one with CX Score, Zendesk’s intelligent triage reports on intent and sentiment on Professional plans and up, and Freshdesk Enterprise answers questions through Freddy AI conversational insights. SentiSum goes furthest, tagging every conversation for reason and sentiment and ranking issues by impact. BI tools with an AI analyst, such as Basedash or Databox Genie, answer plain-English questions about synced ticket data but don’t classify ticket text by default.


### What are the pros and cons of AI insights versus traditional BI for support teams?


AI insights surface changes without anyone building a report, explain them in plain language, and can read ticket text that traditional dashboards ignore. The downsides are cost (conversation analysis is often priced per conversation or per contract), the need to verify AI explanations against the underlying data, and plan limits; Zendesk’s AI quick reports, for example, don’t support custom fields. Traditional BI is more predictable and auditable but needs someone to define metrics and build dashboards. Many teams use both.


### How do I combine Zendesk data with product or billing data?


Get the data into one place. The common pattern is to sync Zendesk, your billing tool, and your product database into a warehouse with an ingestion tool, then analyze it in a BI tool such as Power BI or Metabase. Databox can show Zendesk and billing KPIs side by side without a warehouse, but it doesn’t join records at the ticket or customer level. Basedash includes managed connectors and a warehouse, so Zendesk and Stripe tables can be joined in one query without a separate ETL contract.
